item.title: Mindful Masculinity: Exploring Conscious Brotherhood — Wed Oct 14, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description: **CANCELLED this week for the live Jazz performance.** Next session is Wednesday, October 28 We meet bi-weekly, every other Wednesday · 7:00 – 8:30 PM · $15 Through open dialogue, mindfulness, and other calming practices, we quiet the mind, open the heart, and deepen our connection to ourselves and each other. The circle is open to all male identifying individuals. Meetings are hosted by Leo A. Sante – mindfulness coach, teacher, and dad. We start by sharing our wins and challenges, honoring each voice without judgment or advice. From there, we move into practices that help us release stress, shift perspective, and bring awareness and resilience into our lives. Each week centers on a different theme to help guide us – trust, accomplishment, family, rest, intimacy, presence – as we discover new ways to move through the world as mindful men. Come as you are. Leave more grounded, connected, and inspired. Connect with Leo: Instagram: @holdingpresence Online: HoldingPresence.com Em

item.title: Kill Goofy — Fri Oct 16, 8:00 AM — Grove Street Theater
item.description:
Apricot Sky Productions’s new play, Kill Goofy by Livingston playwright Eric Alter, opens October 9 and plays for three weekends throught October 25. The story is simple on the surface. Two best friends, inseparable at thirteen, haven’t spoken in thirty years. One of them never left his childhood bedroom. His mother never left because someone had to take care of him. Then the other one comes back to town, and everyone in that house has been keeping the same secret. It’s a play about the things we never say to the people closest to us, and it sends people out the door talking. Please note the play deals with difficult subject matter and is recommended for ages 15 and up. The full synopsis and content advisory plus more information are at https://apricotskyproductions.com/killgoofy. Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.description:
Loving Me: Breathwork & Sound Healing with Darren and Gloria of Heal Your Love Sunday morning, October 18, 9:30 – 12 noon, $55 Register for your spot here! Join us every third Sunday of the month for a deeply restorative sound healing with Darren and Gloria of Heal Your Love. We are dedicated to creating a safe and nurturing space for those seeking holistic wellness in a communal setting. Through breath-work and sound healing, we facilitate a deeply restorative experience that helps release anxiety, stress, and trauma from the body while fostering gratitude, peace, and self-love. item.title: Cape May with Everything on it — Mon Oct 19, 7:30 AM — NJ
item.description: Join Louise Zemaitis for this three-day birding workshop exploring Cape May during the best time of year for massive bird fallouts! This is the time at Cape May that the local birders wait for; visiting crowds of keen birders have diminished, yet the most massive bird fallouts of the season commonly occur NOW! Flocks of sparrows, kinglets, bluebirds, American Robins and Hermit Thrushes throng the trees and meadows – and it is now that knowledgeable birders start to sift through the birds in the hope of something really special, since this week starts the season for vagrants in Cape May. It’s also a great time for big raptors like buteos and Golden Eagles, while large seabird flights pass Avalon and Cape May Point nearly every day. Most of the three days will be spent outdoors, learning directly from our field experiences and much of our time will most likely be spent at some of Cape May’s key migration locations. item.description:
In the Spring of 2026, parishioner Ken Traficante began an informal once-a-month gathering of men at Holy Spirit Verona. Having chaired the Building and Grounds (B&G) Committee for many years, Ken wanted to recreate the fellowship that would happen on B&G Work Day events when parishioners volunteered time to clean up and repair items around the Church's campus. Ken scheduled a Saturday morning once a month at the Pilgrim Diner in Cedar Grove with a group of 6-8 guys during which they would share conversation and life experience with one another. item.description: Don’t miss a free conversation with two outstanding social justice authors! item.title: Close Encounters of the 34th Avenue Kind: A Documentary Screening & Conversation — Thu Oct 15, 6:30 PM — Montclair State University School of Communication & Media
item.description: Join us at Montclair State University for a special screening of Close Encounters of the 34th Avenue Kind, an exciting documentary exploring how streets, transportation, and public space shape our daily lives and communities. It IS inspiring, and we’re happy to have it kick off Bloomfield Avenue is a Commons initiative. Bloomfield Avenue Is a Commons reimagines the Avenue as shared civic infrastructure that connects not only cities & towns, urban & suburban, but people. Using public discourse, in-person events, storytelling, art, and analysis, we explore how streets can function as places for connection and democratic life. The documentary features the work and perspective of Clarence Eckerson Jr., founder of Streetfilms and one of the world’s most influential storytellers on transportation, cities, and public space. item.description:
North Jersey Bowling, Volleyball, Tennis & More Join us for friendly and sociable free rallies and possibly some informal matches for training and fun. We are beginner to intermediate levels but all are welcome. We don’t allow formal instruction on our group-reserved courts, although giving some quick tips is OK so long as you’re not holding up others waiting to play.
⛑️ **Clinic Matches:** If we have to rotate people in then we may play some clinic-style matches where everyone rotates in evenly. There is no holding the court via wins so everyone has a chance to play regardless of skill level.
